name: Ordering Irrational Roots
problem:
When we order irrational roots, we can often compare their whole-number intervals first. A root between ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/0cf2eee0cdec31b7acdc244a255aaee7d6d520cfeee67b64ac9cf215f5377477.svg) and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/37e17c4a2302e6352fb7186621c9c43bb5e99d43a8a0bc700c0181d36c6cc915.svg) is greater than any root between ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/402ff5d0c0c3aaa47f18c89f6d96c95d47840eac13822d596a51bdb0c5f9a4ab.svg) and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/85ab4d14e4ae710116ac84de4b03b3cf35723ab969b7abfba97889c497974147.svg)

Suppose we want to identify the greatest number in this list:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/3b5235ec98b311f2a082eeb8a35ba2e606f452a5467707a2125ce3f27fd26484.svg)

We first bracket each root.

- ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/04217800f61f8a2b9dfc2b4efb67a08c1d9f5ef7e365a5ddae4d163146bc0158.svg) lies between ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/0cf2eee0cdec31b7acdc244a255aaee7d6d520cfeee67b64ac9cf215f5377477.svg) and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/b1288d1c08b90d72fcd319980da7943ea4941b9f259ece4086d8b24b1bc0cfb2.svg) since ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/a34f852d765024d8ae773b8debb02adc77fc371c656b049104a9330dc604f5a4.svg)

- ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/5aa880157a445c826aa5e51bfbdf4f3c5ab83afdadf97fc6f533aa6103d28640.svg) lies between ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/0cf2eee0cdec31b7acdc244a255aaee7d6d520cfeee67b64ac9cf215f5377477.svg) and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/b1288d1c08b90d72fcd319980da7943ea4941b9f259ece4086d8b24b1bc0cfb2.svg) since ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/6442e0ee53f3ae690132986dfe60822810ae2f586296bccecba0ab6a07c871db.svg)

- ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/398d865ecee9dba51e8ba4918a187f483b9291ff6ae0d2032be0d95d40190ff7.svg) lies between ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/6cb44f25e489afb06ec62d2e95c4d235ece77eb36e2327b856264d2fb8b22c21.svg) and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/39c9d5c6b02f72e65180a1a782af0404d25977c3627c5778e1bcb676286506c4.svg) since ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/5bf4ba43a56be76e42af12ac6d00913b93191cb348019c518a60bb6490d412ac.svg)

- ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/556af15807fb8546143a7adb4457089c3f367764397c6cf94654f30200177aba.svg) lies between ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/402ff5d0c0c3aaa47f18c89f6d96c95d47840eac13822d596a51bdb0c5f9a4ab.svg) and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/e94ce8a42ab6b97ee9c979dcc0a002b557e1c6339e5950f601a66a9af91f67e5.svg) since ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/65aec0b2f64e5e7991650650102102099e40d0fa3f33b9951e7f42d02bbba8d2.svg)

- ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/ba20e4e917e21ab13b9aab507e09632255fccd6346f08f31333fffd468f3eea1.svg) lies between ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/402ff5d0c0c3aaa47f18c89f6d96c95d47840eac13822d596a51bdb0c5f9a4ab.svg) and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/e94ce8a42ab6b97ee9c979dcc0a002b557e1c6339e5950f601a66a9af91f67e5.svg) since ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/f4638dd2c251dd734b480e1bcaedeb9e1bee07e2f03ff4c85de10287cae9957b.svg)

The greatest value must be one of the roots between ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/0cf2eee0cdec31b7acdc244a255aaee7d6d520cfeee67b64ac9cf215f5377477.svg) and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/b1288d1c08b90d72fcd319980da7943ea4941b9f259ece4086d8b24b1bc0cfb2.svg) so it is either ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/04217800f61f8a2b9dfc2b4efb67a08c1d9f5ef7e365a5ddae4d163146bc0158.svg) or ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/8bdb2119f2b5ebc9f21dcc182d6b68e8e964156168a62cacb6048ca84b6e4dbf.svg) Since ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/eb86e1418a307c988f3b246894cfdf9d0e9c8bbceda1641fb831d30fe9b6fd3b.svg) we know ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/45ee1b9d94d27812c364bf34c46e918d9c2df4b254adbf86932c2d350cde0822.svg)

Therefore, the greatest number is ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/8bdb2119f2b5ebc9f21dcc182d6b68e8e964156168a62cacb6048ca84b6e4dbf.svg)

**Watch out!** We can compare radicands directly only when the roots are the same kind. For example, comparing ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/5aa880157a445c826aa5e51bfbdf4f3c5ab83afdadf97fc6f533aa6103d28640.svg) and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14185481/assets/04217800f61f8a2b9dfc2b4efb67a08c1d9f5ef7e365a5ddae4d163146bc0158.svg) is safe because both are square roots.
